question: Which warriors enter the inconceivable mouth?
premises: Men of various forms are being crushed.
All are cut by various weapons.
inference: Both armies are drawn into the same destructive cosmic mouth.
uncertainties: The fused token dhārtarāṣṭrāśca is kept as one row.
plain_english: Men of various forms, being crushed, enter your mouth of inconceivable form; Yudhishthira's and Dhritarashtra's warriors, all cut by various weapons, enter indeed.
